summary: iter30 Batch B multi-industry dashboards — frontend-only test. All 4 new owner dashboards (hospitality/transport/healthcare/retail) render with 100% of required data-testids present, correct industry-aware sidebar labels (Food Safety/Team Members/VenueInduct/VenueCheck etc.) and correct active-NAV left-border colour accents (#E87722 amber, #0DC4B5 teal, #2196A6 blue, #A855F7 purple, #FFCC00 yellow for trades). Trades owner dashboard preserved unchanged with eyebrow '/ Overview · Trades and Construction'. Cleanup PATCHed back to industry=trades, role_variant=owner. Backend skipped per request.

integration_issues.issue: After PATCH /api/auth/me/industry with role_variant='safety_lead' (industry='healthcare') and reload, [data-testid='safety-lead-dashboard'] is NOT rendered AND [data-testid='healthcare-owner-dashboard'] IS still rendered. Same for role_variant='supervisor' (industry='hospitality') — supervisor-dashboard NOT found, hospitality-owner-dashboard still present. Suggests role_variant from PATCH is not being persisted/returned by /api/auth/me, OR the SafetyLead/Supervisor dashboards use a different testid than 'safety-lead-dashboard'/'supervisor-dashboard'. Dashboard.jsx logic does check variant before industry (lines 60-67), so most likely a backend persistence or testid-mismatch issue.

action_items: Investigate why PATCH /api/auth/me/industry with role_variant='safety_lead'/'supervisor' does not switch the rendered dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx role-variant routing happens BEFORE industry routing — correct order.
DashboardLayout.jsx industryAccent only applied to top-level NAV items (renderedNav loop).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Token key is 'st_token'. PATCH endpoint /api/auth/me/industry accepts {industry, role_variant}.
rca of the issue: Smoke test for role_variant override failed to find variant dashboard testids.
